headline: Samsung’s Galaxy Watch 9 is $40 off at Costco and comes with over $50 in freebies
summary: Costco offers the best preorder deal for the upcoming Galaxy Watch 9. The watch is discounted by $40 and includes over $50 in freebies. The package features two wireless fast chargers and a $50 Costco gift card for $339.99.

headline: LinkedIn actually adds a ‘seems like AI slop’ button
summary: LinkedIn is introducing a new feature to combat AI-generated content. Users can now flag posts that 'seem like AI slop' with a dedicated button. This update aims to reduce the volume of low-quality AI content on the platform.

headline: Govee’s portable smart lamp is down to one of its best prices to date
summary: Govee's rechargeable Table Lamp Classic is on sale at Amazon. It's discounted to $59, saving buyers $21. This price is only $4 shy of its all-time low set during Prime Day.

headline: NASA’s Curiosity rover found a ‘sea of polygons’ on Mars
summary: NASA's Curiosity rover discovered a vast field of honeycomb-shaped polygons on Mars. The 'sea of polygons' covers a Martian valley named Valle Grande. Previously seen in small patches, this is the largest extent of polygonal fractures found.

headline: Marvel's Wonder Man Is Canceled, Won't Return for Season 2
summary: Marvel's Wonder Man TV series has been officially canceled. The show will not be returning for its previously planned second season. Further details on the cancellation were not provided in the snippet.

headline: 'It Was a Bit Too Creepy' - Tom Holland Pitched Man-Spider and Body Horror Elements for Brand New Day
summary: Tom Holland proposed dark, body horror elements for Spider-Man: Brand New Day. His pitches included a 'Man-Spider' concept. The ideas were deemed 'a bit too creepy' for the film.

headline: The RAM Crisis Is Getting So Bad, AMD Is Bringing Back 4GB Graphics Cards
summary: A severe global RAM crisis is impacting the tech industry. AMD is reportedly reintroducing 4GB graphics cards to cope with shortages. This move signals the significant challenges faced in memory component supply.

headline: Dead Cells Developer Motion Twin Responds after Guillermo del Toro Begs for Version Without Respawns
summary: Filmmaker Guillermo del Toro requested a version of Dead Cells without respawns. The game's developer, Motion Twin, has responded to his appeal. Del Toro's specific feedback focused on the game's core respawn mechanic.

headline: European nations to boycott World Cup if Fifa goes ahead with investment plan
summary: UEFA's 55 member associations voted to boycott future World Cups. The boycott threat is against FIFA's proposed investment plans. UEFA states, 'the World Cup is not for sale.'

headline: Thousands evacuated in Crete as wildfires threaten tourist resorts
summary: Wildfires are ravaging the Greek island of Crete, fueled by strong winds. Thousands of residents and tourists have been evacuated. The fires pose a significant threat to popular tourist resorts in Rethymno.

headline: Drought declared across whole of Wales as conditions 'deteriorate'
summary: A drought has been officially declared across the entire nation of Wales. Conditions have significantly deteriorated due to prolonged dry weather. Wales is experiencing its driest July on record in nearly 190 years.

headline: Why limited war with the US may suit Iran better than peace
summary: Iran may prefer a controlled conflict with the US over complete peace. This strategy allows Iran to maintain pressure without escalating to all-out war. The article explores Iran's calculated approach to its relationship with the US.
